name: Button-Sheet
prompt: Rune Rumble, original detailed pixel-art fighting game. Arcade ink interface, dark navy and muted purple, ivory lettering, restrained cyan/coral accents. Deliberate hard pixel clusters and confident outlines. No wooden UI frames, rune glyphs, crystal shards, glossy bevels, blurred lettering, watermarks or extra words. Create a production TRANSPARENT UI asset sheet, 1536x2048 portrait. EXACT two columns by four rows, equal cells. Each cell contains one separate horizontal DARK PURPLE INK BRUSH BUTTON with its COMPLETE EXACT TEXT already professionally centered inside the solid central paint area. Keep ragged brush tips outside the quiet text area. Generous clear transparent gaps, no tile touches another. Flat screen-facing artwork, no perspective. All lettering fully contained with 18 percent safe padding to all paint edges, bold upright ivory hand-lettered arcade capitals, highly readable and consistent letter height, no decorative runes. No subtitles or helper descriptions. Row 1 left text 'SINGLE PLAYER', right 'LOCAL VERSUS'. Row 2 left 'SETTINGS', right 'EXIT'. Row 3 left 'BACK', right 'LOCK IN'. Row 4 left 'FIGHT', right 'MOVE LIST'. Exactly these eight complete buttons in reading order. Each whole button fits within the central 88 percent of cell width and central 35 percent of cell height. Broad solid ink interior, sparse dry-brush fringe, restrained cyan underline. Text and button form one finished asset, not a mockup or screenshot. All outside pixels genuinely transparent.

name: Arena-Name-Sheet
prompt: Rune Rumble, original detailed pixel-art fighting game. Arcade ink interface, dark navy and muted purple, ivory lettering, restrained cyan/coral accents. Deliberate hard pixel clusters and confident outlines. No wooden UI frames, rune glyphs, crystal shards, glossy bevels, blurred lettering, watermarks or extra words. Production TRANSPARENT text-plaque atlas, 1536x2048 portrait, EXACT two columns four rows equal cells. Seven complete isolated dark ink plaques, last cell completely EMPTY transparent. All typography is drawn INTO each plaque, ivory bold upright arcade capitals, professionally centered and fully contained with 16 percent inset from all edges. No other text or labels. Row 1 left is a WIDE SHORT header with exact text 'SELECT YOUR ARENA' on ONE line; row1 right name plaque with exact two lines 'CINDER' above 'QUAY'. Row2 left two lines 'MOONLIT' above 'LAKE'; row2 right 'EMBER' above 'GROVE'. Row3 left 'SKYWARD' above 'RUINS'; row3 right 'STORMGLASS' above 'CAUSEWAY'. All seven plaques fit comfortably inside their own cell with HUGE transparent gutters and no overlaps. Flat front view. Exact spelling, consistent name letter height and line spacing. These are real standalone game assets, no full screen UI or scenery.

name: Eight-Rivals-Backdrop
prompt: Rune Rumble, original detailed pixel-art fighting game. Arcade ink interface, dark navy and muted purple, ivory lettering, restrained cyan/coral accents. Deliberate hard pixel clusters and confident outlines. No wooden UI frames, rune glyphs, crystal shards, glossy bevels, blurred lettering, watermarks or extra words. Create a finished 16:9 game MENU BACKGROUND, 2048x1152, no text or interface. Use the reference ONLY for EXACT identities of all EIGHT fighters. Show exactly eight distinct fighters battling in one lively layered skirmish in a grounded dark canal-town courtyard. Fern green cap/leaf cloak and dark hair uses vines. Ember orange hair/beret/scarf uses fire. Luna white bob/navy crescent cap/cape uses frost. Bram auburn hair/green scarf/stone gauntlets uses earth. Zephyr mint hair/ivory scarf uses wind. Volt brown skin/gold hair/black gold coat uses lightning. Nyx purple bob/dark violet hood/scarf uses shadow. Marin brown skin/navy hair/teal tied headband/navy sleeveless ivory-lapel coat/water gauntlets uses tides. Match big expressive heads and detailed pixel costume designs from reference; no substitute characters or duplicates. Compose three large foreground fighters, two medium middle-ground fighters and three clear smaller upper-background fighters, all eight faces or profiles readable. Coherent opposing attacks rather than a group lineup. Concentrate the action in center and right two-thirds; reserve the LEFT third as quiet very dark masonry and smoke for menu buttons and logo overlay. Keep bottom 12 percent dark and quiet for navigation hints without a drawn footer panel. Restrained broad ink motion arcs, warm body colors separated from a subdued navy environment. Authored 1990s/2000s pixel fighting-game illustration with clear large pixel clusters, limited coordinated palette, no smooth digital painting. Dry worn stone, practical brick walls, simple lamps and canal railing. No huge glowing moon, repetitive impossible castle bridges, wet mirror floors, neon fog, shards, rune decoration, lettering, logos, UI or borders.

name: Cinder-Quay
prompt: Rune Rumble, original detailed pixel-art fighting game. Arcade ink interface, dark navy and muted purple, ivory lettering, restrained cyan/coral accents. Deliberate hard pixel clusters and confident outlines. No wooden UI frames, rune glyphs, crystal shards, glossy bevels, blurred lettering, watermarks or extra words. Create a NEW 16:9 side-view 2D fighting-game arena BACKGROUND, 2048x1152. Location Cinder Quay: a working canal-side service lane at overcast blue hour, dark weathered red-brown brick workshops, practical cast-iron railings, stacked rope/crates at far sides, a simple low canal bridge receding behind the combat lane and a dark workshop doorway. No characters. Dry worn stone paving, NOT shiny wet mirror paving. Authored deliberate pixel art with large coherent pixel clusters and limited palette, calm navy/charcoal shadows, muted umber brick, two small warm lamps with tightly limited light pools. No sun, huge moon, vivid purple sky, giant glowing windows, neon, fog bloom, saturated orange wash, castles or impossible architecture. Perspective is consistent, horizon calm, camera at fighter waist height looking straight across a flat horizontal lane. Floor meets background architecture at EXACTLY 60 percent down the canvas. Top 60 percent is layered grounded architecture and surroundings; lower 40 percent is a restrained open horizontal fightable stone plane. Keep fighting center empty and readable, no foreground objects hiding fighters. Show texture through deliberate placed pixels rather than photographic/grain noise or over-detailed generated texture. This is a production game scenery layer; do not paint manholes because hazards are separate live game objects. No text, signs with letters, HUD, characters, frames, runes, crystals, shards or wood ornaments.
